evidence.quote: We generate substantially all of our revenue from facilitating guest stays at accommodations offered by hosts on the Airbnb platform.
Our single performance obligation is identified as the facilitation of a stay, which occurs upon the completion of a check-in event.

We evaluate the presentation of revenue on a gross versus net basis based on whether or not we are the principal in the transaction (gross) or whether we arrange for other parties to provide the service to guests and are the agent (net) in the transaction.
